veranderings.blok: Lyne wat om die aarde loop
veranderings.rede: 'Na' expresses movement and sits awkwardly with the static verb 'lê'; 'aan die ander kant' is the natural phrase.

veranderings.voor: van die een pool na die ander pool loop
veranderings.na: van die een pool na die ander loop
veranderings.rede: Repeating 'pool' after 'die een pool na die ander' is redundant; idiomatic Afrikaans drops it.

veranderings.voor: Sonder noord of suid en oos of wes
veranderings.na: Sonder noord of suid en sonder oos of wes
veranderings.rede: Two 'of' pairs joined by 'en' are hard to parse; repeating 'sonder' makes the two separate pairs clear.

veranderings.voor: Met die kant by elke getal
veranderings.na: Met die rigting by elke getal
veranderings.rede: 'Die kant' is vague here; the sentence means the direction (noord, suid, oos, wes) written with each number.

vlae.teks: wys waar plekke regtig teenoor mekaar lê
vlae.rede: 'Teenoor mekaar' normally means 'opposite each other', but the sentence seems to mean 'relative to each other'. A previous proposal ('ten opsigte van mekaar') was rejected, so this is flagged rather than proposed again; the writer may want to confirm the intended meaning.
